class.name: ClapInstrument
class.brief_description: A CLAP instrument plugin, played as an audio stream and fed by a [MidiDriver].
class.description: Plays a CLAP instrument (a synth, a sampler) through any [AudioStreamPlayer], [AudioStreamPlayer2D] or [AudioStreamPlayer3D], on any bus. It is a [MidiDriver] target: bind it to a channel, start the player, and send notes. [codeblock] var piano := ClapInstrument.new() piano.plugin_path = "Surge XT.clap" $Player.stream = piano $Player.play() var midi := MidiDriver.create(1) add_child(midi) midi.set_channel_target(1, piano) midi.note_on(1, 60, 100, 1.0) [/codeblock] Notes land on the exact audio sample the driver planned them for, and the plugin follows the driver's tempo and song position (CLAP transport). Notes go to the plugin as CLAP note events where it takes them, otherwise as MIDI 2.0 or MIDI 1.0; controllers, pitch bend, pressure and program always go as MIDI. One playback at a time: keep the player's [member AudioStreamPlayer.max_polyphony] at 1, as every playback gets every note. Plugin windows and saved plugin state are not there yet.

method.name: get_frames_processed
method.description: Frames the plugin has produced so far, over all playbacks.

method.name: get_load_error
method.description: Why the plugin did not load, or an empty string.

method.name: get_parameters
method.description: The plugin's parameters: [code]id[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]min[/code], [code]max[/code] and [code]default[/code] for each.

method.name: midi_event
method.description: A [MidiDriver] target method: the driver calls it with each event (see [MidiDriver] for the arguments).

method.name: midi_stop
method.description: A [MidiDriver] target method: drops what [param source] sent for [param time_us] onwards, and ends its sounding notes there as [param mode] says (see [enum MidiDriver.StopMode]).

method.name: midi_transport
method.description: A [MidiDriver] target method: the driver's transport, which the plugin receives as CLAP transport information, so tempo-synced arpeggiators, LFOs and delays follow the song, to the sample.

method.name: set_parameter
method.description: Sets parameter [param id] to [param value], in the plugin's own range.

members.member: Which plugin of a file holding several; empty for the first.
The [code].clap[/code] file: relative to a plugin folder, [code]res://[/code] or absolute, as for [ClapPluginEffect].
